Try this:

  • In 'Settings' > 'General'
  • scroll down to very bottom and click on 'Config Editor' button

It opens in a new tab

  • In Search type: FolderN
  • look for: mail.useLocalizedFolderNames
  • If it says 'true':
  • use the toggle to change from 'true' to false.

Then restart Thunderbird.

If this works for you please mark this comment as a 'Chosen Solution' as it helps others locate a solution. Thanks.
